name: South Ridge (Scatter Lake)
permit: Free self-issue Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness permit at the trailhead; no quota or fee. Northwest Forest Pass at developed trailheads.

access.landManager: Okanogan-Wenatchee National Forest, Methow Valley Ranger District; Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness

overnight_permit.what: Free self-issue Lake Chelan-Sawtooth Wilderness permit
overnight_permit.where: Fill one out at the trailhead registration box. Most trailheads also need a Northwest Forest Pass to park.

waypoints.name: Scatter Creek/Scatter Lake Trailhead
waypoints.directions: From Twisp, follow the Twisp River Road west about 22 miles; it becomes FR 44 and then gravel FR 4440. The Scatter Creek trailhead, at about 3,100 ft, is about 50 yards past the Slate Creek Trail sign. A Northwest Forest Pass is required to park, and a free wilderness permit is self-issued at the trailhead.

waypoints.name: Abernathy Peak Summit
waypoints.directions: Follow the Scatter Creek Trail through timber beside Scatter Creek, climbing steep switchbacks into the wilderness, about 4.5 miles to Scatter Lake at about 7,050 ft. From the lake, climb the talus slope about 500 ft to the south ridge crest near 7,600 ft, then scramble north along the crest past a series of gendarmes on loose rock to the summit.

approach: From Twisp, drive Twisp River Road west approximately 22-24 miles to the Scatter Creek/Scatter Lake trailhead (~3,100-3,200 ft), about 50 yards past the Slate Creek Trail junction sign. Follow the Scatter Creek Trail through timber alongside Scatter Creek for about 4.2-4.5 miles to alpine Scatter Lake (~7,047-7,100 ft).
